revision: not recorded here — a manifest cannot name the commit that contains it, for the same reason it cannot contain its own hash. The release identity is version + revision + digest: two are in-tree, and the consuming project records the revision in its own pin and verifies with `pack_pin.py <root> --version <v> --sha <full-40-char-rev> --digest <d> --state <state>`. See docs/RP2.2-GATE.md.
digest_note: release-local framing. Verify a release with the tools/pack_pin.py that ships inside it; a manifest naming an algorithm the verifier does not implement fails as a version mismatch, not as tampering.
supersedes: 2.3.0 — not replaced; runs pinned to it stay pinned to it. 2.3.0, 2.2.0, 2.1.1, 2.1.0 and 2.0.0 histories are untouched, and 2.3.0 verifies byte-identical throughout this evolution. MINOR, derived rather than assumed: no authority, contract or migration change is incompatible (`requires.routing` is new and defaults to false; no public name is removed), and the release ships tools that did not exist, which PATCH does not cover.
version_semantics: PATCH: backward-compatible fixes, metadata/docs corrections, enforcement of already-promised guarantees. MINOR: new backward-compatible policy/tool/capability. MAJOR: incompatible authority, contract or migration change. VERSION is the single machine-readable authority (DECISIONS.md D11).
pin_instruction: a project records ROOT PATH and version and full 40-character sha and tree digest and state in PROJECT.yaml pack.*, and verifies them rather than copying them. All four identity fields are required: `root_path` says WHICH DIRECTORY, the other three say WHAT is in it, and a pin without the root is UNVERIFIABLE_LEGACY_PIN (tools/pack_migration.py) because the release it names cannot be identified. Adoption happens only at a capability boundary. A frozen release never mutates during a project run; verification failing mid-project is a stop, not a pin to refresh.
concurrent_use: several projects may pin this same release at once, or different qualified releases, provided each version resolves to a distinct immutable root. Operational state and Evolution Candidate inboxes are project-local and never written into this repository (DECISIONS.md D13).

external_installed_skills.authority: ADAPTERS, NOT AUTHORITY. Outside this release envelope, covered by no tree_digest_sha256, and changeable without a pin noticing. Where an adapter and this pinned pack disagree, the pinned pack wins. From 2.2.0 an adapter a project dispatches through is DECLARED AND VERIFIED under the project's own adapters contract (tools/adapter_pin.py, PROJECT.yaml `adapters:`) — this list is an observation of what was installed here, never a substitute for that declaration (DECISIONS.md D12, D14).

known_limitations: STATE IS IN_PROGRESS. This is a candidate, not a release. No project may pin it. Moving it to QUALIFIED_AND_FROZEN is a human decision (policy/hitl-matrix.md row 2), and this candidate needs a SECOND human decision besides: the narrowing in docs/RP2.4-D26-PROPOSED.md is a row-7 governance change. THE COORDINATOR WROTE THAT ENTRY INTO DECISIONS.md AND AN INDEPENDENT READER CAUGHT THE SEQUENCING: row 7's application point is BEFORE an entry lands, so the entry was removed from the decision layer and is held as a proposal. The commit that briefly carried it is in this branch's history and is named in the gate record; rewriting that history is itself rows 2 and 4. Both decisions are in docs/RP2.4-GATE.md under 'the freeze procedure'; the coordinator took neither.

held prose 2931 lines against a ~2000 target (46.6% over, recorded not shaved). 1896 lines are in-release and that half is UNDER the target; the 1035 that put the total over are the two installed adapters, outside this envelope, covered by no digest and impossible for this pack to freeze — and counted anyway, because they are loaded every session. 2.3.0 was 2675 (33.8% over) on the same rule. Delete-before-adding was applied: the adapter's static table of model slugs was REMOVED rather than updated, because a table that is wrong about what exists is worse than no table.

THE COORDINATOR REPRODUCED THE FAILURE CLASS THIS RELEASE SHIPS THE TOOL AGAINST, TWICE. Three hand-written background monitors matched their own command lines and could not terminate; after building the mechanism that refuses exactly that, the coordinator wrote a fourth one and had to retire it. The repair is structural (docs/RP2.4-D26-PROPOSED.md, proposed D27) and the bound is unchanged and unclaimable: a wait the coordinator never declares is invisible, because seeing it would mean policing the coordinator's own shell.

THREE MUTANTS TONIGHT WERE ILL-FORMED AND FIRST READ AS WEAK GUARDS. A matrix row edited in a cell the guard never parses; a CLI wrapper removed from a tool that already handled the inputs itself; a `-k` selector matching nothing. A mutant whose subject never sees it is not evidence — the same rule as fixtures, one level up — and the third is why tools/selector_evidence.py exists.

TWO DELTA READINGS FROM TWO PROVIDERS RETURNED NOT SOUND ON FOURTEEN FINDINGS, AND THE BLOCKER WAS THE DESIGN RECORD BEING RIGHT WHILE THE IMPLEMENTATION WAS NOT. The record said a command-line-matching waiter is refused AS A CLASS; the code was a five-literal denylist plus a fallback a shell COMMENT could satisfy, and six waiters walked past it — including one that observes nothing and can never end. Repaired by reconstruction: a waiter is governed only if `waiter_command` rebuilds it byte for byte. All fourteen findings were reproduced before repair and seventeen mutants die. THE REPAIRS ARE THEMSELVES UNAUDITED, which is the standing condition of any final repair.

ONE READING COULD NOT EXECUTE THE SUITE AND THE OTHER COULD, AND EVERYTHING THAT TURNED ON EXECUTION CAME FROM THE SECOND. It found the recorded test count irreproducible under an ordinary TMPDIR (a `-k` selector matching pytest's own generated directory name), and a shipped guarantee with NO ORACLE AT ALL — a mutant inverting the dashboard's derivation passed the entire suite. A reader that cannot run the subject reads a different thing, and the difference is stated rather than averaged into one verdict.

THE COORDINATOR SHIPPED THREE REPAIRS WITHOUT ORACLES AND A MUTATION PASS CAUGHT IT. Three of seventeen mutants survived their first run because the repair had been made and the test had not. `a repair with no oracle is a claim` is this pack's own rule, met by its own coordinator, in the release that states it.

THE PER-CONFIGURATION QUALIFICATION TABLE IS NEARLY EMPTY, AND THAT IS THE HONEST STATE OF THIS EVIDENCE. No observation recorded before this release carries an observed model, an authentication class or an execution surface, so all of them are family-level prior and none is a track record. HOW MANY CARRY A COMPLETE IDENTITY IS NOT RESTATED HERE — it changed within one commit of being written and an independent reader caught the stale figure. Run `python3 tools/qualification.py`, which prints the count and both tables from the log. Every other configuration answers `unprobed` with a prior beside it. Nothing was fabricated to fill the table and nothing was deleted; the remedy is recording an observed identity at the next dispatch, which is the adapter's job and not this pack's.

GPT-6 ASTRA IS PROVISIONAL WHERE IT HAS EVIDENCE AND UNPROBED EVERYWHERE ELSE, AND THE TASK CLASSES ARE NOT LISTED HERE — the list went stale within one commit and an independent reader caught it. `python3 tools/qualification.py` prints them with every keyed dimension, including the effort that makes two of them DIFFERENT configurations rather than one model at two task classes. It is NOT confirmed anywhere, and in particular it is `unprobed` at blind_closure_audit_cross_vendor where the family-keyed derivation returns `confirmed` on seven observations. One dispatch each against one alternative is a comparison and not a rate.

THE RELEASE-AUTHORITY READING RETURNED NOT READY ON FOUR BLOCKERS AND ONE WAS THE COORDINATOR'S OWN PROCESS. HEAD moved while the reading was in flight, so the auditor compared the earlier manifest against the later tree and correctly reported a digest mismatch that does not exist in either revision. The other three were real, reproduced by execution before repair, and each is closed by an oracle that fails against the pre-repair behaviour with the mutant killed: a provenance spelled `unobserved` reached `confirmed`; a declared probe filled the mandatory cross-provider leg AND THE ADOPTION REHEARSAL EXPECTED IT TO; and a whitespace producer established independence. THE REPAIRS ARE THEMSELVES UNAUDITED until a delta re-audit, which is the standing condition of any final repair.

THE RELEASE-AUTHORITY READING COULD NOT EXECUTE THE SUITE. Its read-only sandbox gives pytest no usable temporary directory, so it collected the suite, read it, and executed the candidate's sources in memory rather than running the tests or mutating files. Its coverage is reasoning and collection rather than execution, which is a real bound on what that round establishes and is stated rather than implied by the verdict.

BOTH DESIGN READINGS CAME FROM ONE PROVIDER THROUGH ONE CLIENT. They are independent of the coordinator and of each other's session, and they are NOT independent of each other's provider. tools/routing.py refuses exactly that pairing for a leg declared cross-provider; this release's own design audit did not have a second provider available to satisfy it.

OLD ROUTES WERE NOT RE-PROBED AFTER THE CLIENT UPDATE. The client moved 0.149.0 -> 0.153.3 deliberately, because execution proved the older one could not run the model under evaluation. Every availability observation for a previously-used configuration was recorded on 0.149.0, and availability_for reports that rather than carrying it across, so those configurations read UNKNOWN on the new client until something dispatches. That is a real cost of the update, stated rather than papered over.

A SURFACE THAT CANNOT REPORT THE EFFORT IT RAN AT CANNOT PRODUCE A COMPLETE IDENTITY. The keyed effort is the OBSERVED one, because this execution surface accepts an effort it will not run at. Where a surface reports the model and not the effort, the configuration stays incomplete and therefore unprobed. The remedy is in the adapter; this pack will not infer the value, because inferring it is the substitution the release exists to prevent.

THE CLIENT BUILD IS NOT IN THE QUALIFICATION KEY, AND THAT IS A CLAIM ABOUT THIS EVIDENCE BASE ONLY. Both independent readings were asked for an A/B pair where a build change altered what a configuration can do; neither could produce one from this log. The decisive falsifier is named in the design record, and tools/qualification.Invalidation is the governed response when it appears. It is not a claim that client versions are irrelevant — this session watched one refuse a model the next accepted, which is an AVAILABILITY difference and is keyed as one.

AN INVALIDATION THAT DROPS ADVERSE EVIDENCE CAPS THE IDENTITY AT `provisional` PERMANENTLY. It is what stops a declaration being used to delete a contradiction into a qualification, and it means a configuration whose adverse history was invalidated cannot reach `confirmed` again from evidence alone. Restoring it is a human decision, which is what declaring the invalidation was.

A DENYLIST OF UNOBSERVED PROVENANCE CANNOT CATCH A FABRICATED ONE. Completeness refuses the provenance markers an adapter actually writes when it did not observe an identity. An adapter that invents a method name passes. That is an explicit trust boundary — the independent reader that found the underlying defect said the same — and the alternative, an allowlist of admissible surfaces, is a vocabulary that ages exactly the way the model vocabulary this release replaced aged.

THE GENERATION PATTERN DOES NOT COVER A BARE CODENAME WITH NO VENDOR PREFIX. Deliberate: a bare codename is an ordinary word in some language, and this pack's own tiering rationale rests on a measured case where exactly that produced four findings and zero true positives. Such a name is caught where it appears with its prefix, and is otherwise a literal a project adds to its own vocabulary.

THE PACK'S OWN COMPLETE HISTORY CARRIES UNADJUDICATED OCCURRENCES, AND THIS RELEASE ADDS TO THEM. The figure is measured with this release's own tools/publication_history.py over the complete reachable history at the strict tier and is recorded in docs/RP2.4-GATE.md rather than here, because a count restated in two places goes stale in one. The generation pattern raises it: this repository IS the denylist and its records discuss the vocabulary, which is the case skills/core/public-safety.md describes. Adjudication is owed before any first remote and is recorded as owed, not as done. A private remote does not resolve it.
REVIEW_LOCAL contradicted on one observation; EXTRACT_LOCAL provisional on two. Carried unchanged from 2.3.0, and now readable as what it always was: family-level prior evidence.
relative yield between AUDIT_PRIMARY and AUDIT_CROSS is still unmeasured. The audits are not run as a comparison and a count is not a rate.

THE EVOLUTION WORKSPACE IS A WORKTREE, BECAUSE A LIVE PROJECT PINS THE PACK'S WORKING CHECKOUT BY ROOT PATH. That is the D18 layout defect the 2.2.0 manifest named as the finding most deserving a decision, and it is unchanged: the older pinned root verifies only because it happens to sit on its pinned revision, and ordinary development in it would break a live pin. This candidate avoids the hazard rather than removing it. Relocating that project's release root is the founder's decision and was explicitly not taken during this session.

AN ADAPTER PIN NOW VERIFIES THE EXECUTABLE A PROJECT DECLARES, AND NO PROJECT DECLARES ONE YET. The mechanism is demonstrated against the live installation — the drift this release reproduced is reported correctly once the executable is declared — but every real contract on this machine still declares files only, so every real report reads '0 executable(s)'. The declaration is the project's to make and was not made on its behalf.

installed adapter skills and agents live outside this repository and are not covered by tree_digest_sha256; they are covered instead by a project's declared adapters contract, which is verified rather than frozen

PROSE CLAIMS ABOUT THIS RELEASE'S OWN HISTORY ARE CHECKED BY A READER, NOT BY A TEST, except where a guard binds one. 2.2.0 recorded this as the likeliest remaining defect in its candidate on four rounds' evidence, and this candidate inherits the condition unchanged.

THE ADAPTER PATH IS UNEXERCISED BY ANY REAL CONSUMER. One of the real projects on this machine declares adapters; the rest do not, so most of the adapter surface is covered by constructed fixtures only.
the tree digest is computed over WORKING-TREE BYTES, so a checkout with core.autocrlf=true produces a different digest for the same commit. There is no .gitattributes.

THE CAPACITY GATE HAS NEVER BEEN RUN AGAINST A LIVE PROVIDER READING. Every fixture supplies its own pool figures, and the one documented resource surface this pack can read (tools/resource_observation.py) reports UNKNOWN in the ordinary case by that surface's own definition. What is exercised is the arithmetic, the refusals and the conservative posture; what is not is whether a real reading arrives in the shape the gate expects.

THE DIAGNOSTIC PROJECTION SHIPS AGAINST THE EVIDENCE, ON A HUMAN DECISION. The reconciliation this release draws on refuses a dashboard in terms — a human wanting one is not evidence that Core should ship one — and the refusal is recorded rather than reversed. What answers its concrete objection is the ordering: coordinator state is derived rather than stored, so there is no stored value to go stale. It is a one-shot renderer with no port, no cache and no importer, and removing it is deleting one file.

A REAL PROJECT ON THIS MACHINE STILL CARRIES A PRE-2.1 CONTRACT and this release does not migrate it. The refusal now names the schema generation and the migration instead of reporting a type error, which is the repair; performing the migration is the project's, because the two private-term tiers differ in whether a term applies to blob content and choosing would change what gets scanned.

A CLOSE ATTESTATION DOES NOT VERIFY THAT A PROFILE RAN. The outcomes are supplied by the caller and the state is derived from the exit status the caller records; a caller that records a falsehood records a falsehood. What the mechanism makes impossible is SILENCE — a declared profile cannot be absent from the record. An earlier draft of the module's headline promised independent verification of what ran, which it does not provide; an independent auditor found the sentence and it is corrected rather than left standing.

A DESTROYED CITATION IS DETECTED BY LENGTH, NOT BY PROVENANCE. A forty-character object name this repository does not have is treated as a citation of something gone, and a shorter one as prose. That boundary is a judgement about how people write records, not a fact about Git: a forty-character token that never was a revision would be reported as destroyed. The alternative — treating every unrecognised hexadecimal word as a lost commit — produces a remediation list nobody can act on, which is the failure the adjacent publication work exists to prevent.

THE FAILURE-MODE CLOSURE MATRIX IS THE RELEASE'S OWN CLAIM AND IS NOT INDEPENDENTLY AUDITED AS A WHOLE. Each row cites a test or a rehearsal that can be run, and the auditors of round 1 exercised many of them individually, but no auditor has been asked to falsify the matrix as a document. Its five open residues are stated in it rather than in a summary.

A PATH-BASED WAIT CANNOT NAME A PRODUCER. An unrelated writer satisfies a PATH_EXISTS or EXIT_FILE wait, and no property of a bare filesystem path distinguishes who wrote it. The observation is strengthened as far as a filesystem permits — a regular file that does not predate its own wait — and OUTPUT_ROOT, whose owner marker is now checked on read as well as on write, is the kind that establishes a producer. A test pins both halves.

THE PROJECTION IS A READER AND HAS NEVER BEEN WATCHED DURING A REAL MULTI-HOUR RUN. It now renders as a page as well as as text, and both were falsified against twelve synthetic states, but nobody has yet watched either during a long run. Its fields are exercised against fixtures and against this session's own live record, where it correctly reported a stale record and an undeclared audit subject. Whether the information architecture is the right one for someone watching a Consumer-A run for six hours is not established, and cannot be until someone does.

THE PROGRAM-VALUED CONFIG LIST IS NOT COMPLETE AND CANNOT BE. It enumerates the shapes of Git config keys whose value is executed; Git may add another, and a key that matches no shape is not inspected. What the design buys is that an unrecognised key MATCHING a shape refuses rather than waiting to be found — the population of routes is open-ended and the population of shapes is smaller and slower-moving, not closed. It also costs two extra Git processes per repository per invocation, about 17 seconds on a 110-second suite.

ONE MECHANISM IS DEFERRED RATHER THAN COVERED: contract, classification and sandbox gaps, inherited from 2.2.0 with no discriminating oracle demonstrated in this release. Recurrence is bounded because the 2.2.0 contract checks ship unchanged and their tests still run, but that is inheritance rather than a demonstration made here, and the final evidence-closure check reclassified it rather than let it read as covered.

A FILESYSTEM CLONE DEFEATS THE CHUNK LINK-COUNT CHECK. `cp -c` on APFS puts one task's bytes in another's root with st_nlink == 1 on both, and nothing on disk distinguishes that from bytes the second task wrote. The ownership guarantee rests on the owner marker and the completion marker, both of which are checked; it does not rest on the bytes. Found by an independent reader in cycle 10, declared rather than closed, and now stated as a bounded guarantee with an oracle: what IS guaranteed is that two roots are never confused, which was executed and holds; what is not is that a root's bytes were computed by its owner. The error cannot cause unsafe acceptance.

THE CHUNK LINK-COUNT CHECK HAS A FALSE POSITIVE: a task that hard-links its own product into its own root classifies UNKNOWN. Wrong in the safe direction — UNKNOWN loses nothing, because `resume_plan` refuses to act on it — and recorded rather than narrowed.

`_bundle_contains` COMPARES BUNDLE TIPS ONLY, so a commit reachable inside a verified bundle but not named as a head reports UNREACHABLE. Safe direction: it blocks where it should anchor. Proving reachability inside a bundle means unbundling, and this release does not write.

THE ARTIFACT GUARDS COST ABOUT 60 SECONDS OF THE SUITE'S 171. `test_every_oracle_the_matrix_names_selects_at_least_one_test` spawns one pytest collection per matrix row, which spawn one pytest collection per matrix row and per recurrence class. Recorded because a check whose cost nobody measured is a check somebody eventually disables, and because the alternative — trusting that the selectors still match — is what it exists to replace.

A BUNDLE CANNOT ANCHOR ANYTHING IN THIS RELEASE. Establishing that a bundle carries a commit means indexing its pack, which is a write, so a verified bundle whose header names a cited commit yields ANCHOR_UNCONFIRMED and BLOCKS. That is strictly more conservative than 2.2.0's behaviour and it is a real cost: a project that anchors closures in bundles will find those closures blocked until a person adjudicates them. Revisit when a read-only way to enumerate a pack's objects is available, or when the write is authorised for a scratch index.

AN ORACLE SELECTING A TEST DOES NOT PROVE IT TESTS THE MECHANISM IT IS CITED FOR. The matrix guard establishes that every citation resolves to something that runs, which is strictly weaker than relevance. Relevance is a human judgement and no check here makes it; the citations were chosen by the coordinator and read by nobody else.

THE VISUAL IDENTITY IS CHOSEN AND IT IS ONE PERSON'S CHOICE. Monochrome is the default lens, the temperature is neutral-to-warm, no purple appears anywhere, and a FOUNDER preset and a FOUNDER CONTROL ROOM layout ship built in. Four other lenses ship beside it. What is established by test is that every lens holds contrast, perceptual tone separation and a readability floor that rises with the viewport, and that Matrix's large surfaces stay below a browser-computed luminance ceiling. What is NOT established is that these are the right choices for anybody else: they were made by looking at previews, and the settings panel exists because the next reader will disagree.

THE DASHBOARD HAS NEVER BEEN WATCHED DURING A REAL MULTI-HOUR RUN. Both renderers are falsified against twelve states, two themes and two viewports, and against this session's own live record. Whether the information architecture is right for somebody four hours into a Consumer-A run is not established and cannot be until someone is.

THE EVENT HISTORY IS DELIBERATELY INCOMPLETE AND SAYS SO. Seven event classes ship because seven are what durable artifacts date; a capability opening, an audit being dispatched and a finding being recorded are not among them, because nothing writes their time down. One class, `deadline passed`, is arithmetic over durable fields and the clock rather than a recorded fact, and is marked `derived` and filterable for that reason. A durable event log is recorded as an Evolution Candidate, not shipped.

THE REMOTE SIDE OF REPOSITORY ACTIVITY IS AS OF SOMEBODY ELSE'S LAST FETCH. This release never contacts a network, so `REMOTE-REPRESENTED` is read from remote-tracking refs and is exactly as current as the last fetch performed outside it — which the view reports where the repository records it and declines to guess where it does not. A declared remote nobody has fetched reads REMOTE NEVER OBSERVED, which is not the same as a remote with nothing on it.

REPOSITORY ACTIVITY READS 366 DAYS BY DEFAULT, NOT A COMPLETE HISTORY. The window is a render-cost decision, `window_days=0` reads all of it, and the view names the window it read. A multi-year calendar is an Evolution Candidate.

NEITHER HISTORY IS EVIDENCE OF QUALITY, AND ONLY A TEST KEEPS IT THAT WAY. A commit count measures that commits happened. No productivity, velocity, developer or good-day figure is derived anywhere, and the guard that holds this is a vocabulary refusal over the rendered page rather than anything structural: a future contributor who wanted such a figure would have to delete a test to get it, which is the point.

THE DESIGN GATE CANNOT STOP A CALLER WHO DECLARES A MATERIAL CHANGE TRIVIAL. The change class is an input because Core cannot know which of a project's changes are material, and `TRIVIAL` resolves to NOT_REQUIRED. The declaration is recorded in the readiness report, so it is a visible claim an auditor can dispute rather than a silent omission — but it is detection by disclosure, not prevention, and D25 says so.

THE DESIGN GATE CHECKS THAT A DESIGN WAS MADE, NEVER THAT IT WAS GOOD. It reads a record and answers whether that record states alternatives, a rejection with a reason, failure modes, authority boundaries and frozen oracles. Whether the selected design is the right one is product meaning, which Core does not adjudicate. A well-formed record of a bad design verifies.

PERSISTENCE ACROSS A COLD BROWSER RESTART IS NOT VERIFIED ON THIS HOST. A preference surviving a reload is verified in the browser; surviving a NEW BROWSER PROCESS is not, because headless Chrome hangs on this machine whenever `--user-data-dir` names a fresh profile, and the alternative — writing into the operator's own default profile — is a side effect on their browser. What is established instead: the page holds no state outside `localStorage`, re-reads it on every load, and falls back to the default for a stored value that is corrupt, unknown or unusable. Storage outliving a process is the browser's guarantee, not this page's, and this release does not claim to have tested it.

A SEMANTIC AND A NEUTRAL CAN STILL BE CLOSE AS TEXT. Separation is enforced across what the charts PAINT — ink, bad, warn, unknown, good — because those are areas a reader has to tell from the area beside them. As text, monochrome's warn sits near its dim, and every lens's restrained accent sits near its ink deliberately. Forcing those apart would contradict the brief the palettes were built to: UNKNOWN is steel in every lens, and the accent is meant to be quiet. Every state's text also carries a glyph, so colour is not the only channel — but colour alone does not distinguish them, and this says so.

THE LIVENESS MODEL GOVERNS DECLARED WAITS AND NOTHING ELSE. A wait recorded in the continuation record must name a deadline, and past it the state is RECOVERY_REQUIRED whatever the process is doing. A waiter a coordinator writes by hand and never records is outside that: the model cannot see it, and acquiring the power to see it would mean policing the coordinator's own shell. Measured in this release's own session — five undeclared waiters survived ninety-five minutes after their workers had exited. The pack ships `progress.waiter_command` so that a coordinator need not hand-write one; using it is discipline, not enforcement.
